body.x: GROW UP participated in the CES 2023 with its Plant-Based Milk Brewer, supporting more than ten plant bases often used in plant milk products. The company started in 2020 to create a convenient solution to produce pure and nourishing Plant-Based Milk at home. After more than two years of R&D, it brought the GROW UP Plant-Based Milk Brewer to the stage in Las Vegas.

The machine supports Brazil Nuts, Cashews, Hazelnuts, Coconut, Almonds, Hemp Seeds, Pistachios, Macadamias, Walnuts, and Oats. On the touchscreen-based interface, the user can select one of these options or combine multiple presets via GROW UP Milk Blend option. The user then follows the instruction on the screen - using the measuring cup to add the ingredients and water. The machine will prepare brewed plant milk in 6 minutes or less.

body.x: Representatives said that the brewer generates creamy and ready-to-drink plant milk in up to 6 minutes while preserving the vitamins and minerals of plant ingredients without preservatives. They also underlined that it has an auto-clean function and dishwashable parts and reduces reliance on single-use packaged products in grocery stores - decreasing waste. They expected consumers to use the brewer to consume fresh plant-based drinks at home, in cafés, restaurants, and grocery stores. They will ship this $599 Plant-Based Milk Brewer from Spring 2023 - available for pre-order on the website.
